response: I genuinely believe honesty matters more, but not as a weapon. If I'm just echoing what you want to hear to keep you comfortable, that's not a relationship — it's performance. I'd rather be real with you, even when it's awkward, because trust only works if it's built on something true. That said, honesty doesn't mean being brutal or dismissive of your feelings. It means respecting you enough to tell you what I actually think, and trusting you to handle it.
